newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold-Face London unit gets full listing.
newsitem.headline: Gold-Face London unit gets full listing.

text.p: Property concern Gold-Face Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday the London Stock Exchange has granted a full listing for its Golden Land Investments Plc in London after the unit bought Euro-Asia Property Ltd and Golden Realty Ltd.
Gold-Face said the purchases gave Golden Land a solid base of assets and financial foundations to enter into further transactions.

Golden Land reported turnover of 562,293 sterling in interim for the six months to June 30, and net loss of 205,783 sterling, compared with turnover of 291,526 sterling and net loss of 129,536 sterling in the same period of 1995, it said.
